name: word-editor
description: A browser-based, Word-compatible rich-text editor. The client remains zero-dependency vanilla ES modules with hand-written OOXML (WordprocessingML) mapping. The Node server reuses that same client-side DOCX parser for server-side conversion (via a jsdom DOM shim) and adds a small set of server-only infra dependencies (jsdom, redis) for production multi-instance deployment.
